approved_scope.trigger: One push on codex/spiralcore-shared-runtime whose exact SHA matches SPIRALCORE_RUNTIME_SOURCE; attempt one only.
approved_scope.transport: Existing authorized HTTPS trycloudflare origin and separately prepared receiver; HTTP body accounting only.
approved_scope.authorization_boundary: This source review authorizes no account creation, tunnel/server startup, secret mutation, push, or remote execution by this reviewer. Parent coordinates authorized execution after local qualification/source freeze.

verified_controls: Push-only branch trigger, exact-source and first-attempt checks both at job level and in executable shell gate.
Read-only repository permissions, dedicated non-cancelling concurrency group, and commit-pinned checkout/upload actions.
Dedicated runtime variable/secret namespace; benchmark capability injected only into final transfer step, never source build/test steps.
Strict HTTPS origin allowlist excludes credentials, port, path, query, fragment, lookalike suffix, and malformed hostname.
Fresh target-directory guard and compiler/target/wrapper override rejection; locked Rust 1.97.1 source compilation on x86_64 Linux.
Frozen canonical-vector test plus complete relevant release suite/check/Clippy before benchmark credential use.
Fixed plan independently checked for expected source/run/configuration, nine fixtures, 36 unique scopes, and 72 operations.
Tracked source hashes and executable hashes checked before transfer; executable hashes checked afterward.
No explicit retry; bounded execution and a non-replayable run-attempt gate.
Always-seal and always-upload steps preserve available evidence; missing upload or incomplete records never imply success.
Sender completion expressly remains pending stopped-receiver exact object verification and joined evidence.
Pilot contract explicitly excludes 30-pair acceptance, reliable tail claims, pure byte-on-line timing, complete path traffic, and energy.

independent_qualification.result: Actual YAML parsed; all embedded Bash passed syntax/ShellCheck warning gate; valid synthetic configuration/capability accepted; all 17 invalid fixture cases rejected.

remaining_execution_requirements: Freeze source and retain exact local and hosted executable/configuration custody.
Use a fresh receiver cache and the same exact plan; corroborate operator-supplied receiver executable hash.
Retain raw workflow and receiver evidence, including failures, beyond hosted artifact expiry.
After server shutdown, compare all 72 receiver objects and join their scope/identity receipts to sender records.
Report observed byte, CPU, and time axes independently, with practical cold-start baseline and unfavorable controls.
limitations: Hosted job has not run in this review; a future successful workflow run is not assumed.
GitHub runner loss or timeout may prevent always-step completion; missing artifacts mean an incomplete pilot.
Repository variables, source revision, endpoint readiness, live credentials, hosted account budgets, and actual receiver identity were not mutated or verified here.
The gate checker is qualification of this reviewed workflow; it is not a formal proof of arbitrary future YAML.
